live.overviewHint: Last {n} days against the same days before. Pick a metric for the daily trend.
live.overviewHintNoCompare: Pick a metric for the daily trend.
live.mixed: These accounts use different currencies. Pick one account.
live.looseLine: {n} listings have no style, {share} of LIVE GMV. See how to fix.
live.unassignedFix: Put the style code into the seller SKU of each variant, or at the end of the title.
live.estimatedHint: Sold through a listing shared by several styles; split by orders during the session, no impressions or clicks
live.accountsHint: Logins of the LIVE manager, separate from the shops. Add as many as you need.
live.cookieSubtitle: Import the LIVE manager login cookie. The account is checked before saving.
live.step1: Install Cookie-Editor in Chrome and log in to shop.tiktok.com/streamer with the LIVE account.
live.step2: Open Cookie-Editor on that page, click Export and choose JSON.
live.step4: Log in, export and add each account separately.
live.security: A cookie is a login. It stays on this computer, is never uploaded or logged. Do not share it.
live.removeConfirm: Removing "{name}" clears the local login and synced sessions. Nothing changes on TikTok.
live.assignedHint: Most sales come from generic listings without a style code. Use one variant per style with the code as seller SKU, or single-style listings with the code in the title.
live.noCodes: No LIVE sales with a style yet
live.unassignedTip: Neither the title nor the variant SKUs of these listings carry a code.

reason.noCode: No code in title or SKU

error.json: Paste the JSON exported by Cookie-Editor
error.api: The LIVE manager returned no data, try again later

title: Shops
subtitle: Manage every TikTok Shop login in one place. The same login is used by Creator Hub and Sales & Inventory; update it here once and both use it.
emptyDesc: Click "Add shop" and paste the login cookies exported from Seller Center or Affiliate Center.
expiredNotice: {n} shop login(s) expired. Click "Update cookies" on the shop to import them again.
removeConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Its login and Creator Hub data are removed; import cookies again to use it.
sharedHint: Cookies are stored encrypted on this computer only and never uploaded. When a login expires, Creator Hub and Sales & Inventory both say so; update it here.
hubSubtitle: Every shop's daily business at a glance. Open a shop for trends, traffic, where sales come from, and products. Read-only sync from Seller Center.
dataNote: Today's numbers are real time; "last 7 days" and similar use complete days (today excluded) so comparisons are fair. Older data comes from Data Compass and settles within 1–2 days. While the app is open it updates every hour.
analysisHint: Looks at yesterday and the last 7 days: why sales moved, plus stock, service and to-do problems.

health.title: Shop health
health.empty: No health data yet; click Sync.

report.title: Shop morning report
report.subtitle: Every morning each shop is analysed and sent to a desktop notification and your Feishu group.
report.desktopOff: Desktop notifications are off in Settings; turn them on first.
report.feishuReady: Goes to the Feishu group set in Settings → Health & automation.
report.feishuMissing: No Feishu group bot set up yet.
report.how: After {hour}:00 each day the app syncs every shop, analyses yesterday and sends it. Klipmill must be running.
report.none: No report yet; click "Generate and send now".

profit.title: Profit
profit.formula: Profit = GMV − platform fees − product cost − ad spend (by order date, estimated)
profit.feeUnknown: Not enough settlements yet; sync first
profit.noGmvMax: GMV Max is not connected; once it is, ad spend is included automatically.
profit.linkMissing: The linked ad account is no longer in GMV Max
profit.settled: {n} settled in the last 7 days, {amount} paid
profit.missingTitle: {n} selling SKUs have no cost price
profit.missingHint: Needed for an accurate profit. Enter once; units sold are costed automatically.
profit.note: The fee rate comes from this shop's settlements of the last 45 days; refunds and subsidies follow the actual settlement.
profit.emptyDesc: To estimate profit we need to know the platform fees, which takes at least 20 settled orders for this shop. It appears automatically after a sync; new shops usually need 1–2 weeks of settlements.
profit.subtitle: estimated by order date

syncDone: Sync finished; data is up to date

pc.emptyDesc: Sync your shops once to read each product's views, clicks, add-to-carts and sales from Data Compass → Product card for the last 90 days.
pc.verdictHint: Each product is compared with its own shop's average. Click a group to see only those products.

verdictDesc.winner: Clicks and sales both strong: restock and push
verdictDesc.potential: Buyers like it, needs more exposure
verdictDesc.leaky: Clicked but not bought: check price, images, reviews
verdictDesc.weak: Seen enough but rarely clicked: change creative or stop
verdictDesc.steady: Close to the shop average, keep watching
verdictDesc.testing: Too few views to judge yet

pc.overviewHint: Last {n} complete days vs the same number of days before. Click a metric for its daily trend.
pc.searchPlaceholder: Search name, product ID or SKU code

advice.restock: Stock will not last long: restock about {qty} units.
advice.winner: Test passed: CTR and conversion are at or above the shop average. Scale ads and videos.
advice.potential: People who see it click and buy, but few see it. Post more videos or run GMV Max.
advice.leaky: Clicks are fine but few buy. Check price, main image, detail page and reviews.
advice.weak: It had enough views but its CTR is well below average. Change the image or creative, or stop it.
advice.steady: Around the shop average. Keep watching; the result updates automatically.
advice.testing: Not enough views yet. Let data build up before judging.

pc.note: From Seller Center Data Compass → Product card, counted by people and updated daily for the day before. People summed over several days can overlap, so rates are the better guide. Stock and restock advice come from Sales & inventory and need the product's SKU codes.
